note: Floyd County TX has no published zoning district layer: the county's public GIS products list parcels, city limits and subdivisions only, and ArcGIS Online searches for Floyd County return only TWDB groundwater, parcel and boundary layers. Texas counties generally do not zone. Floydada's city website links no zoning map or GIS service. Lockney's zoning ordinance (ecode360) adopts a zoning map that is not published online as a queryable service.
